    from collections import defaultdict
    weight_sums = defaultdict(int)
    for u, v, w in edges:
        gu = refinement[u]
        gv = refinement[v]
        key = (min(gu, gv), max(gu, gv))
        weight_sums[key] += w
    aggregate_edges = sorted([[k[0], k[1], v] for k, v in weight_sums.items()], key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    group_to_nodes = defaultdict(list)
    for node, group in refinement.items():
        group_to_nodes[group].append(node)
    members = {}
    for group in sorted(group_to_nodes.keys()):
        members[group] = sorted(group_to_nodes[group])
    return {"aggregate_edges": aggregate_edges, "members": members}"}
